the Indian Ocean (Andaman Sea) to the South China Sea.

to the Sea of Marmara.

Ocean (Gulf of Aden). The Strait of Hormuz links the Persian 
Gulf with the Gulf of Oman. The Strait of Malacca connects 
the Indian Ocean (Andaman Sea) to the South China Sea.
